translations.web: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
translations.bsb: When they were unable to repay him, he forgave both of them. Which one, then, will love him more?”
translations.kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
translations.asv: When they had not wherewith to pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?
